title: Shortest path in a binary matrix
statement: In an n × n grid of 0 (open) and 1 (blocked), return the number of cells on the shortest 8-directionally connected path from the top-left to the bottom-right cell, or −1.
hints: Mark cells when you enqueue them, not when you dequeue them.

solution.explanation: BFS finds shortest paths when every edge costs the same. Marking on enqueue keeps each cell in the queue at most once; marking on dequeue can enqueue a cell up to 8 times.
